summary:
Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature across six files; nothing was run, so all verification is by reading only.

Changes:
- monai/data/utils.py: iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs; coordinates are computed by removing the padding offset from each slice (channel row included). Docstring updated with Yields and Note. set_rnd skips attribute names starting with "__".
- monai/data/grid_dataset.py: added PatchIter (prepends channel entry to patch_size, normalizes start_pos with ensure_tuple, validates mode via NumpyPadMode, delegates to iter_patch with copy-back off). Reworked GridPatchDataset(dataset, patch_iter, transform=None, with_coordinates=True) with length check, worker split, per-patch apply_transform(map_items=False), and coordinate toggle. Replaced np.float with float in PatchDataset docstring. Removed the math import; worker split uses integer ceiling division.
- monai/data/__init__.py: exports PatchIter.
- docs/source/data.rst: PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset.
- tests/test_grid_dataset.py: new module with TestGridPatchDataset (test_shape, test_loading_array), module-level generator, setUp/tearDown seeding.

Judgment calls:
- PatchIter's channel Note is in the class docstring.
- setUp seeds with 1234 and test_loading_array also calls set_determinism once at its start, as the spec reads.
- Docstring example outputs were derived by hand.

Not verified:
- Tests were not run. The pinned patch values in test_loading_array are unverified; I only checked they are consistent with arange(16) images and per-patch shifts.
- Black formatting was not run; line lengths were checked by search and only pre-existing lines exceed 120.
- No other callers of iter_patch or GridPatchDataset exist in the repo. No commits made.
